integrity: All enumerator inputs are constructed in the embedded Python and C++ sources; independent graph constructions, exact finite cycle predicates, explicit isomorphism, automorphism orbit cover and the two structural counts are checked. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification restricted to Desargues graph. Scalar minimum and general regular-decycling identity are published prior work. Primary generalized-Petersen papers (2013, 2015) could be inspected only at abstract/metadata level; earlier unindexed enumeration cannot be ruled out. No theorem for a generalized Petersen family or full induced-forest polynomial is asserted.
title: The 2,860 optimal decycling sets of the Desargues graph
